notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.12
notes.notes:
Version 1.12 changelogs:

[list]
[*] Improved UI for Leaderboard
[*] Better hook animation
[*] Arrows binding is now available
[*] No more freezes while restarting Infinite levels
[*] Pause no longer appears when switching to gamepad
[*] Restart while in slowmo no longer breaks the game
[/list]
